recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group decides that contained resources should no longer be characterized as a collection mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-7383 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction asking to resolve a mismatch where the text said there were five mechanisms for communicating collections of resources while the reporter saw only Group, List, Bundle, and Composition described; the recorded resolution said to fix the count to four.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-7383 was found. Git history shows d72b1d787aaf640be8506e68be27e728ccbef9ec added the five-mechanism List boundary section before the Jira was filed, including a fifth DomainResource.contained bullet, and the current source still has five bullets.
additional_context: The Jira comments include the initial 'fix to four' note but also a later 2017 editor comment, 'theres 5 now.' The active fhir.ini resources section includes list=List, so source/list/list-introduction.xml is in build scope. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no relevant later issue or community discussion changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source changes. Changing the count to four would make the current active source inconsistent because the section now explicitly lists List, Group, Composition, Bundle, and DomainResource.contained.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue asking to resolve a five-versus-four collection-mechanism mismatch, with comments first saying to fix to four and later noting there are now five.
evidence_items.learned: The reconciliation must account for the later Jira comment and the current source state rather than mechanically changing the count to four.

evidence_items.summary: The List introduction says there are five mechanisms and enumerates List, Group, Composition, Bundle, and DomainResource.contained.
evidence_items.learned: The current source is internally consistent with a five-mechanism statement.

evidence_items.summary: The resources section contains an active list=List entry.
evidence_items.learned: The inspected List introduction is in current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: The 2015 commit 'Clarified the relationship of various collection types. {#5289}' added the five-mechanism section including DomainResource.contained.
evidence_items.learned: The fifth mechanism was deliberately present in source history, not merely a stale generated artifact.

evidence_items.locator: Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches for five/four collection mechanisms
evidence_items.command: bun run jira:search fts '"five mechanisms" "four mechanisms"' --limit 20; bun run jira:search fts '"collections of resources" Group List Bundle Composition' --limit 20; bun run zulip:search fts '"five mechanisms" OR "four mechanisms"' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-7383; bun run confluence:search fts '"five mechanisms" OR "four mechanisms"' --limit 10
evidence_items.query: five mechanisms OR four mechanisms; collections of resources Group List Bundle Composition; FHIR-7383 references
evidence_items.summary: The focused Jira searches found FHIR-7383 and no relevant superseding issue; Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant hits or references.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community or later Jira evidence changes the source-based no-change conclusion.

evidence_items.locator: combined branch idempotency check for FHIR-7383
evidence_items.summary: No prior FHIR-7383 reconciliation commit was present on the combined branch before this worker commit.
evidence_items.learned: Publishing one empty audit commit for the seed did not duplicate an existing reconciliation.
